title: Wang2021 – Combined SSVEP dataset with single stimulus location for two inputs
description: A derivative EEG dataset implementing a combined steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) brain-computer interface paradigm with spatially overlapping stimuli presented at a single location. The dataset comprises 8 healthy subjects performing a covert attention task to discriminate four arrow directions (up, down, left, right) flickering at distinct frequencies (7.73–14.17 Hz) derived from an 85 Hz CRT refresh rate. EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz using a 32-channel ANT Neuro system across two experimental schemes examining different attentional mechanisms.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 1000 Hz sampling rate using a 32-channel ANT Neuro eego mylab amplifier with standard 10-05 electrode montage. Each trial consisted of a 500 ms fixation period, 500 ms cue presentation, and 5000 ms stimulus presentation. Participants attended to one of four overlapping SSVEP arrow stimuli flickering at frequencies of 14.17, 12.14, 9.44, and 7.73 Hz.
